title: DVMap: Fine-Grained Pluralistic Value Alignment via High-Consensus Demographic-Value Mapping

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model predictions on value-based multiple-choice questions against ground-truth data from the World Values Survey across diverse countries and demographic groups to measure pluralistic alignment and mitigate Western-centric value dominance.

Conducting a robustness analysis by counterfactually inverting the 'Income' attribute (High vs. Low) in demographic prompts to quantify how often the model's value predictions shift solely due to changes in economic status.
